text:
maria.g: quick follow-up to the quant RFC: i prototyped an observability/event schema for quant artifacts so the console and oncall can triage fp8/int8/4bit regressions. want quick sanity checks before i PR.

samir: looks useful. is this per-profile or do we tie it to model+profile+route?

maria.g: model+profile+route. goal is to correlate failures to specific customer routes and prompt anchors so we can narrow root cause faster.

aj: please include an example payload and a console query so ops can wire alerts.

maria.g: here's the prototype i demoed (keeps sensitive fields out):

"artifact_event: model=redwood-v2-medium; profile_id=fp8-aggressive-2026-03; route=/chat/generate; fidelity_budget=0.12; degrade_score=0.87; quality_anchor=qa_set_v1; anchor_examples=[weather_report_short, task_extraction_long_prompt]; token_index=23; residual_norm=0.042; kv_mismatch=false; sample_output_snippet=\"...less specific about dates...\"; redacted=true; ttl_seconds=604800; explainability_uri=\"gs://redwood-quant-explain/2026/abc123\""

li: nit: use snake_case everywhere and add a severity bucket {low,medium,high} for quick dashboards. also add event_id and profile_version.

maria.g: updated mental model: snake_case + bucket + event_id. console should show a small diff against the anchor example when available.

ops-bot: /observe quant-artifacts --since 24h --profile fp8-aggressive --group-by route,model

jenna: suggested metrics to emit: quant.artifact.count, quant.degrade.p50, quant.degrade.p95, quant.anchor.regressions, quant.residual_norm.avg. include tags for customer_tier and canary_flag.

samir: question: do we emit a heavier explainability payload when degrade_score>0.8? token-level deltas could be helpful but costly.

maria.g: yes but gated. default is explainability_collected=false. when true we emit explainability_uri and a small metadata blob about collection_cost_ms and size_bytes. retrieval requires admin scope.

aj: ops: retention+pii rules matter here. sample_output_snippet must run through a redaction step. recommend two TTLs: metadata_ttl (longer) and sample_ttl (shorter).

maria.g: agreed. i'll add redaction_flag, metadata_ttl_seconds, sample_ttl_seconds. adding a sample console query and an alert sketch below:

"console query: /observe quant-artifacts --since 1h --degrade_score>0.7 --filter route:\"/chat/generate\""

"alert sketch:
WHEN quant.degrade.p95 > 0.75 for 10m
THEN page oncall -> include top anchor_examples and sample diffs (if available)
AUTOMATIC_ACTION: add profile to shadow-sampling for 1h"

li: add an "artifact_resolution" event type with resolution_reason enum {rollout_rollback, profile_tweak, false_positive, noop} so product and comms can close the loop.

maria.g: will add artifact_resolution with resolver_name and resolution_notes. will include a small backfill script to tag historical artifacts by profile_version.

jenna: +1 on TTLs and admin-only explainability retrieval. also suggest we tag artifacts with estimated_cost_ms and storage_bytes for chargeback visibility.

samir: can we add a tiny benchmark note in the schema doc: explainability collection adds ~0.5ms p99 and ~20kb per collected artifact? product needs ballpark numbers.

maria.g: yes will include the microbenchmark results and a recommended default of explainability_collected=false and canary-only enable.

aj: one more ops ask: include a compact json example and a prometheus-friendly label set so we can emit metrics without parsing the whole blob.

maria.g: done. plan: open PR with schema, console mockups, backend shim that emits to telemetry pipeline, and a short ops runbook (redaction, TTLs, admin access). tagging people for review. :pray:

ops-bot: maria.g mentioned samir, aj, li, jenna in #eng-ml
